# Hero Section 🎪

#### Course: Figma to Code

## Hero Section 🎪

The hero section is the big introduction area right below the header. It's the first thing people notice, and it quickly tells them what this page is about.

![Creating the Hero Section](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

In our design, the hero section includes:

- an avatar card (the photo inside a card-style box)
- the main headline and short intro text
- two buttons (the main actions)

Most hero sections follow the same idea. A strong headline, a short description, and a clear action to take.

Next, you'll create the hero container in HTML.
